blocks.html:
Welcome to IHOT programming! Work through this checklist in your first week. Ask a lead or mentor whenever you get stuck; that is what we are here for.

  1. Install the WPILib suite for the current season (it includes VS Code, Java and all FRC tools).
  2. Install Git and create a GitHub account, then ask a lead to add you to the team organization.
  3. Clone the current robot code and make sure it builds on your laptop.
  4. Read the Zero-to-Robot guide below, then deploy code to a practice robot with a lead watching.

Safety note: always tell the drive team before you deploy or enable a robot.

blocks.html:
How we work in Git

  • Create a branch for every feature or fix. Never commit straight to main during build season.
  • Commit small, working changes with clear messages.
  • Open a pull request and get one review before merging.
  • Tag the code that runs at each event so we can always go back to it.

blocks.html: You do not need to know Java before joining. Focus on classes and objects, methods, if/else and loops, and interfaces. That covers most of what robot code uses.
